summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 2,892,023 Class I shares to feeder vehicles for ~$30.8M at $10.6443 NAV per share under Sections 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S. The filing also discloses class-level NAV as of March 31, 2026. No strategic transaction, acquisition, tender, or activist event is involved. The sale is a routine capital-raising activity exempt from registration, not a special situation. The disclosure is purely informational with no board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics beyond the exemption reliance. The filing is a routine update for a non-traded REIT.
